description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Catalog/GetProducts. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Provides supplier candidates for publication. ownerAgent: catalog-sources. Opening the catalog returns stored recommendations; explicit web, AI chat and MCP searches discover products through a deep internet search that may take several minutes. Use when: Use for catalog/source candidate discovery, not existing store inventory, importing store products, stock checks or ranking active listings. AI chat and MCP may search and apply the documented catalog filters, including themes, seasons and occasions such as Mother's Day gifts. Warn the user in their language before starting that a deep internet search may take several minutes; do not require confirmation for this read-only search. Input: CatalogProductsRequest. Header channel identifies the selected store and country. Search=false or omitted returns all type-0 country recommendations; SessionId preserves random order. For explicit searches from the web, AI chat or MCP set Search=true. Search accepts SourceIds, PriceFrom/PriceTo, ProfitFrom/ProfitTo, Prime options, Criteria as only the human-written free-text product search prompt (not a literal title substring) and optional Tags (selected theme/category integer IDs, using the same IDs as AI Publisher orders). When SourceIds is omitted or empty, searches use up to four distinct eligible supplier domains with the highest priority for the store's country and channel; source ID ascending breaks priority ties. Explicit supplier inclusions or exclusions retain their existing behavior. Theme, category, trending and store exclusion filters remain separate from Criteria. When Criteria is empty, categories and seasonal themes are expanded into related product families before searching; a human-written Criteria skips this expansion. Trending remains a search requirement. Price/profit requirements use effective channel/supplier settings and fees. For example, a Mother's Day product search uses {"search":true,"criteria":"Mother's Day gifts"}. Do not invent a quantity parameter; show the requested number from the returned candidates. Output: Returns Products with SourceId, Url, Title, ImageUrl, SourcePrice, ChannelPrice, Profit and SubOrigin. Initial candidates have CatalogSelection=1; search candidates have CatalogSearch=2. Publish by URL rather than ProductSourceId. Initial mode returns the complete stored country collection. Search returns at most 50 candidates total and can return fewer or none when no eligible products are found. TotalResults and PageSize are the returned count. Search terms: catalog getproducts. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
